text: [excited] This security camera flies around your house... and it's loud on purpose!
In twenty twenty, Ring promised it for two hundred fifty bucks. Shipping next year.
[amused] Six years later, it's finally here. Same price.
First, you carry it around your home so it learns the map.
It naps in its dock until an alarm goes off. Then it zooms in to look.
[amused] Every minute in the air? Eight minutes on the charger.
[deadpan] And if the Wi-Fi drops... it just lands.
[playfully] Would you let one patrol your house? Send this to a gadget lover.
